subject.why: The drive-in speaker post is clearly recognizable with both hanging speakers, cords, top red light, and the screen in the background.

category.why: The foreground strip contains scattered pebbles and rocks, violating the rule against busy terrain and scattered scenery.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The central speaker post is well-framed with ample breathing room on top and sides.

colour.why: The palette is overwhelmingly cool, desaturated grey and white rather than the bright, warm, and juicy look of the references.

detail.why: There is realistic micro-texture/mottling on the metal surfaces and realistic scattered gravel across the ground.

style.why: The rendering leans too photographic with realistic surface weathering and depth-of-field blur on the gravel, missing the clean, smooth, toy-like satin finish seen in the references.

fix: Remove the scattered pebbles and surface grime, clean up the metal into smooth stylized shapes with a satin sheen, and inject warmer, more saturated lighting.
